# What does federal excise tax really cost your winery or cidery per bottle?

> Free federal wine and hard cider excise tax calculator for wineries and cideries: enter cases, bottles and bulk gallons, see wine gallons, the $1.07 rate, the CBMA credit tiers, the tax per bottle and what growth does. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
